findings.finding: The change is safe because the owner owns every file by default. .github/CODEOWNERS leaves only app and server source, tests, harness, assets, native iOS files, shared contracts, and skill records without an owner, and it gives back every dotfile, dot folder, *.config.* file, package manifest, lockfile, tsconfig, Podfile, and Gemfile at any depth. tools/__tests__/codeowners.test.js applies GitHub's last-match rule to every tracked file and to new files such as packages/server/src/.gitignore, packages/app/src/.npmrc, packages/app/src/.eslintignore, packages/server/.prettierignore, and packages/server/nitro.config.ts. It fails when the default owner line, the dotfile line, or the config line is removed, when tools/ loses its owner, or when packages/app/ios/ gains one. git ls-files with the same patterns as an exclude file gives the same 164 owned files out of 301 as the test's matcher.

A project .npmrc could send the dependency audit to another registry. tools/verify.cjs now sets npm_config_registry for every check it runs, and npm ranks the environment above a project .npmrc. With a stub-registry .npmrc and the old environment, audit:check sent its bulk advisory request to the stub and failed. With the new variable, the stub got no request and audit:check passed against the public registry. verify:commit on a commit that adds the stub .npmrc on top of this range made no request to the stub.

A nested .oxlintrc.json replaced the root lint rules for its folder. With {} in packages/server/src/.oxlintrc.json and a line that breaks eqeqeq and the type-assertion rules in api.ts, oxlint without the flag exited 0. npm run lint now passes --disable-nested-config and exits 1 with those rules named. The only tracked .oxlintrc.json is the root one, so the flag changes nothing today.

No oxlint or oxfmt flag stops a nested .gitignore from hiding source. With src/ appended to packages/server/.gitignore, npm run lint still exits 0 on the probe line. Ownership is the control, so packages/server/.gitignore and any new nested .gitignore, .eslintignore, or .prettierignore now need the owner's review.

Docs, root files, package-root files such as packages/app/App.tsx and app.json, and packages/app/android now have the owner. The controls rule mirrors that set, so a change to them routes blast-radius, and a small edit to them no longer qualifies for the tiny tier. routing-committed.test.js now expects controls for docs edits, a readme plan, and skill edits, and a 2-line skill edit is no longer tiny.
findings.none: Intended by the owner-by-default rule, and the routing test pins it.

findings.finding: tools/github/integration-rules.json now equals the live ruleset, rule by rule, after adding the rebase-only merge method, the extra approval for unattributed changes, and the empty reviewer list. ruleset.cjs passes the parameters through unchanged, and ruleset.test.js still passes.

The range adds one test, data lines in CODEOWNERS, routing.json, and the ruleset, one environment variable in verify.cjs, one lint flag, and doc sentences. The test has no casts, guards, or try/catch.

The range adds two comments. tools/__tests__/codeowners.test.js states that GitHub applies the last matching CODEOWNERS line, which the repo cannot change. tools/verify.cjs states that the registry variable overrides a candidate's own .npmrc, which the code cannot show. The comments were checked by hand instead of with the comment-sicko subagent.
findings.none: Both comments explain a why the code cannot show.

findings.finding: The ownership proof is a jest test that runs on every verify. Each mutation failed with the predicted diff. Removing the default owner line or unowning tools/ listed the newly unowned files, such as tools/__tests__/app-config.test.js. Owning packages/app/ios/ made project.pbxproj expect false and receive true. Dropping docs/** from controls listed the five docs files as owned but not routed. Restoring each file made all 24 cases pass.
findings.cites: Script the check when you can

findings.finding: The range removes more than it adds. routing.json goes from 22 rules to 11, and motion-lines.cjs is deleted. CODEOWNERS is now a default owner line, an unowned source list, and an owned config list. The controls rule is a positive list because routing globs cannot negate, and the test fails when it and CODEOWNERS drift in either direction. Generating one list from the other would need a generator, and the test is smaller. No file passes 1000 lines.
The changed doc sentences and the controls rule's why use plain words and state one rule each, with no dashes and no colon connectors. One long guard sentence was split in two before the docs commit.

AGENTS.md states the ownership rule once in Checks and repairs and the merge rule once in Completion evidence, as positives, and points at .github/CODEOWNERS for the full list. The controls rule's why says it mirrors CODEOWNERS instead of naming a stale subset.
